h1: Custom 16 oz Koozies for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 16 oz koozies in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for cans and bottles. Get your brand noticed today.
introHtml: Custom 16 oz koozies are designed to fit standard 16 oz cans and bottles, making them a practical choice for outdoor events, tailgates, and corporate giveaways. Unlike smaller sizes, these koozies provide a snug fit that keeps beverages cold longer while protecting hands from condensation. Choose from neoprene or foam options and add your logo with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation. Whether you need a simple branded sleeve or a full-wrap design, 16 oz koozies offer versatile promotional opportunities for your next event.
heroAltText: Custom 16 oz koozies with a branded neoprene sleeve for promotional events
